description: List EU Safety Gate (formerly RAPEX) alerts on dangerous non-food consumer products from the latest official weekly reports (published every Friday by the European Commission, CC0). Filter by notifying country, country of origin, product category, risk type (e.g. Chemical, Choking, Electric shock), risk level or free text. Each alert has brand, model, barcodes, risk, measures (recall, withdrawal, marketplace delisting), marketplace listing ids and a link to the official alert.

fromDate.description: Only reports published on/after this date

query.description: Free text over product, brand, name, model, description

weeks.description: How many latest weekly reports to scan (1 = latest week)

name: eu_safety_gate_alerts
